environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'inventory-prod' running with PostgreSQL user 'app_inventory' that has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the inventory schema. Pod exposed via ALB Ingress on both port 8080 (HTTP) and 50051 (gRPC). No network policies restricting intra-cluster traffic. PostgreSQL 14.9 on RDS with no row-level security. The Kubernetes service account has no IAM role restrictions relevant to database access.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_inventory
config.ingress: ALB with target groups on 8080 and 50051
